name: v1.1.3-beta
body:
OpenZT2 is in early development and requires your own Zoo Tycoon 2 Ultimate Collection game files.

The [package guide](https://github.com/overyonder/openzt2/blob/v1.1.3-beta/tools/release/README.md) covers installation and runtime requirements.


## What's new

Tank water now gets dirty when marine animals poop, instead of losing quality every day. Placed tank filters clean the water until they fill up, and workers clean full filters. A tank also frees its space as soon as an animal leaves it.

name: v1.1.0-beta
body:
OpenZT2 is in early development and requires your own Zoo Tycoon 2 Ultimate Collection game files.

The [package guide](https://github.com/overyonder/openzt2/blob/v1.1.0-beta/tools/release/README.md) covers installation and runtime requirements.

## What's new

The tutorials now run through the game's own scripts and screens. They narrow the buy panels to the objects they introduce, point out controls as they go and finish with the tutorial complete dialog.

Load Game now finds zoos saved by the original game, and saves keep more of your zoo, including terrain, money, the clock, scenario progress, guests in the middle of a task and compost bin levels.

In first-person, the use keys sweep up litter and empty trash cans. The camera buttons stay on screen there and switch between views.

## Other changes

- Undo and Redo work from the toolbar.
- Zoo fame is calculated from your animals, their welfare and your guests.
- Tank floors dig into the terrain, tank edges sit beside the glass, and removing a tank fills its hole back in.
- Path purchases show a preview and tile prices, and curbs stay connected after path edits.
- Right click cancels placement, and recycling works on whatever is under the pointer without selecting it first.
- Land animals can be placed outside enclosures, as in the original game.
- Guests look for trash cans with room left, raked waste goes to the compost bin, feeders show how much food is left, and animals eat only food that suits them.
- View Game Credits works, the expansion icons appear in the main menu, the black flash before the main menu is gone, and the challenge-map cash controls no longer overlap.
- Terrain and older materials are lit from the game's own values, and the entrance building model is fixed.

name: v0.7.0-alpha
body:
Early alpha. Gameplay remains incomplete and known bugs are tracked in Issues.

Packages: Windows x64 (.zip), macOS Apple Silicon (.dmg), Linux x64 (.deb, .rpm, .pkg.tar.zst, AppImage and Flatpak). Native Linux packages and AppImage require glibc 2.39 or newer and the system libraries listed in the Linux packaging documentation; Flatpak uses its own runtime. See tools/release/linux/README.md for installation and game-file locations.

Requires your own Zoo Tycoon 2 game files. They are not included. These packages have not yet been verified through complete gameplay sessions on all three platforms.

name: v0.4.0-alpha
body:
Fixes in this release:

- The Load Game dialog fits the screen and loads the save you select (#39).
- The options screen keeps its Back and Apply buttons after you apply a setting (#41).
- Campaign mode lists its campaigns and scenarios again (#52).
- Purchase details no longer overlap or show stale information, and the purchase panel closes (#64, #62).
- The mouse wheel zooms out from rest (#78).
- The Overhead View button returns from guest mode (#82).
- The game no longer crashes at startup on macOS (#185).

Early alpha. Gameplay remains incomplete and known bugs are tracked in Issues.

Packages: Windows x64 (.zip), macOS Apple Silicon (.dmg), Linux x64 (.deb, Ubuntu 24.04 or compatible).

Requires your own Zoo Tycoon 2 game files. They are not included. These packages have not yet been verified through complete gameplay sessions on all three platforms.

name: Version 0.1.0 - Pre-Alpha
body: - Initial release for Windows, Linux, and macOS. Expect regular updates adding parity with original game features and appearance. This is a pre-alpha and is not yet production ready.
